intent: Count how many of the 5 specified product variants have available_today_quantity >= 2 in the Lend district PowerTool store.

params.spec1_family: Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw
params.spec2_family: Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag
params.spec4_family: Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag
params.spec5_family: Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer

success_criteria: Lend district PowerTool store resolved to a single store_id + record_path
Each of the 5 specs resolved to its matching product_sku via family_name+brand and product_variant_properties (property_key/value)
available_today_quantity in the Lend store fetched per matched SKU
Count = number of specs whose matched SKU has available_today_quantity >= 2
refs cite the store path and only the available (>=2) product paths, not unavailable ones

args.stdin: SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name, city FROM stores WHERE city = :district OR store_name LIKE '%' || :district || '%' LIMIT 1;

WITH store AS (SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = :district OR store_name LIKE '%' || :district || '%' LIMIT 1), specs(spec_no, family_name, brand, prop_key, prop_val) AS (VALUES (1, :spec1_family, :spec1_brand, :spec1_prop_key, :spec1_prop_val), (2, :spec2_family, :spec2_brand, :spec2_prop_key, :spec2_prop_val), (3, :spec3_family, :spec3_brand, :spec3_prop_key, :spec3_prop_val), (4, :spec4_family, :spec4_brand, :spec4_prop_key, :spec4_prop_val), (5, :spec5_family, :spec5_brand, :spec5_prop_key, :spec5_prop_val)) SELECT s.spec_no, s.family_name, s.prop_val, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS avail FROM specs s JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_name = s.family_name AND pf.brand = s.brand JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = s.prop_key AND pvp.property_value_text = s.prop_val LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store) ORDER BY s.spec_no;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
